An Overview Of This Role

As Senior Manager, Data Science, you'll lead Product Data Science: a team of 6 Data Scientists within GitLab's data organization, reporting to the Director of Data Science. You have two mandates:

Drive product impact now. Set the analytical agenda for your product areas and make sure the team's work changes decisions.
Build the merged Data Science function. Define excellence for a Data Scientist who blends analytics and data science, and grow the team to that bar.

You lead mainly through others, and step in hands-on when it matters: reviewing a model, pressure-testing an analysis, or writing the query yourself.

What You’ll Do

Set a long-range vision and roadmap for Product Data Science, and show the team how its goals connect to company strategy
Own prioritization and trade-offs across product areas, and adapt the team as priorities shift
Be the go-to partner for Product and Engineering leaders on complex and urgent questions, choosing the right approach: a deep dive, an experiment, or a production model
Raise risks and resource gaps early, and bring senior leaders clear options to drive timely decisions
Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team: build career paths, act on team feedback, and make tough talent decisions when needed
Build a high-trust culture of urgency and accountability, where the team communicates openly, shares progress on a predictable cadence, and delivers quality results on time
Set standards for experimentation, causal inference, metric definition, and production modeling

What You’ll Bring

10+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, including 3+ years managing data science or analytics teams in B2B SaaS or tech
Strong product sense and a track record as a trusted partner to Product and Engineering leaders
Exceptional communicator who makes complex problems and findings clear to any audience, from Product leaders to executives, and coaches others to do the same
Thrives in ambiguity: structures undefined problems, gathers the right information, and makes sound decisions on high-risk, cross-team issues
Courage to challenge: offers dissenting views, asks tough questions, and fosters inclusive debate
Deep expertise in statistics and experimentation, including hands-on use of quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity score matching)
Expert SQL (Snowflake preferred) and strong Python, with experience taking ML models to production
Fluent with AI tools, with sound judgment on when AI output can be trusted
Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values

Nice to Have

Experience with developer tools, DevSecOps, or product-led growth products
Experience measuring adoption and quality of AI-powered product features
Thought leadership in data science or analytics, internally and externally
Advanced degree in a quantitative field

About The Team

Product Data Science brings Data Science and Analytics together into one function. Our Data Scientists are business partners first, pairing strong product judgment with deep skill in SQL, Python, statistics, and machine learning. We help Product and Engineering decide what to build, measure what worked, and understand how customers get value from GitLab.

The opportunity is growing fast. AI is driving growth in GitLab's consumption business, creating new ways for data to drive growth. As AI takes over routine reporting, the team focuses on the hard problems: experimentation, causal inference, production models, and recommendations leaders act on.

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
Join Skild AI’s manufacturing team to help ensure robots, accessories, and incoming materials meet design requirements and quality standards. In this hands-on role, you will perform in-process and final inspections, verify incoming material conformity, and complete visual inspections of returned robots and accessories. You will document findings, identify nonconforming products, and work with manufacturing and engineering to resolve quality issues.
Responsibilities
Inspect incoming components, materials, and subassemblies against engineering drawings, specifications, approved samples, and applicable inspection criteria to verify design conformity and quality.
Perform in-line and in-process inspections at designated assembly checkpoints. Verify workmanship, component placement, hardware installation, cable routing, connector seating, labeling, and other defined acceptance criteria.
Complete final inspections of manufactured robots and accessories before release. Verify required inspection and test records are complete and products meet documented acceptance criteria.
Perform visual receiving inspections of all incoming return material authorization (RMA) robots and accessories. Document physical condition, visible damage, missing components, identification labels, and other observed discrepancies.
Record RMA inspection findings and photographs, as appropriate, and communicate observations to repair personnel. Distinguish observed conditions from suspected causes requiring further evaluation.
Use appropriate measuring instruments, inspection tools, and visual inspection methods to check dimensions, fit, finish, and assembly quality. Verify equipment calibration status before use.
Identify, label, and segregate nonconforming material or products according to established procedures. Document discrepancies and escalate issues for authorized disposition.
Maintain accurate inspection records, checklists, and quality data, including part numbers, serial numbers, inspection results, and supporting evidence as required.
Communicate recurring defects and quality trends to manufacturing, engineering, and quality personnel. Support root-cause investigations, corrective actions, and improvements to inspection processes.
Coordinate inspections with production and receiving priorities while maintaining consistent acceptance standards. Follow safety, material handling, and 5S practices and perform other assigned quality duties.

Preferred Qualifications
At least 5 years of experience in quality control, quality inspection, or a similar role supporting electro-mechanical manufacturing.
Experience performing incoming, in-process, and final inspections of mechanical parts, electrical components, or assembled products.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, specifications, bills of materials, and inspection instructions.
Hands-on experience using calipers, micrometers, and other inspection or measuring equipment appropriate to the product.
Ability to evaluate electro-mechanical assembly workmanship, including hardware installation, PCBA placement, cable routing, connector engagement, and labeling.
Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when comparing inspection results with documented acceptance criteria.
Experience documenting defects, maintaining traceable inspection records, and handling nonconforming material through established procedures.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to describe defects objectively and work effectively with production, receiving, repair, and engineering teams.
Ability to organize inspection priorities, work independently within defined procedures, and escalate unclear requirements or quality concerns.
Comfort using Google Docs, Google Sheets, email, and electronic quality or production systems to record and communicate inspection results.

Additional Experience We Value 
Experience inspecting robots, automated equipment, or similar complex electro-mechanical products.
Experience documenting the condition of RMA products and supporting repair or failure-analysis teams.
Familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, sampling plans, and applicable workmanship standards.
Experience with ERP or product lifecycle management systems, such as Rootstock and Arena, and supporting corrective actions or continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements 
The role involves regular sitting, standing, and walking in a manufacturing environment, as well as close visual inspection and hands-on use of inspection tools. Handling components and accessing inspection points on robots and accessories may require bending and reaching. Essential job functions may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.
